div.p: Resolution is not admission. RESOLVED only means "this key provably belongs to member M, who claims this profile." Two further, independent decisions follow:

ul.li: Operational — may M use this relay? The allow-list gate (core.enforceAccess): an open relay auto-admits and records the member trust-on-first-use; an invite-only relay rejects with ErrNotAllowed until an invite is redeemed.
Trust — should you believe M is who they claim? An edge decision: pairing, a shared room, or the relay directory. Never the chain's answer.
